subject: SOC 2 Type II artifacts request + vendor security questionnaire kickoff
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@crestlinehealth.com>, Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II artifacts request + vendor security questionnaire kickoff

Hi Liam / Alyssa,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the candid discussion about Crestline's use case and dataflows. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- SOC 2 status: you mentioned Crestline completed a Type II in Sep 2026 and has an internal bridge/attestation process for interim months. If possible, could you share the full Type II report (redacted as needed) or the bridge letter that covers coverage through Q1 2027?
- Trust portal access: we'd prefer uploading/receiving artifacts via your vendor portal. If you can invite our security mailbox (security@redwood.ai) or give a temporary upload link that would be ideal.
- Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ): to accelerate our procurement and legal review, we'd like to kick off a short VSQ. We can accept a completed Crestline vendor questionnaire or provide our questionnaire if that's easier.

Proposed immediate asks (ordered by priority):
1) Share SOC 2 Type II report or an interim bridge letter (PDF).
2) Provide portal invite or a one-time upload link for evidence.
3) Point us to the correct procurement contact for contract redlines.

If you can attach the interim summary or point me to the document in your portal, I will circulate to our Security and Legal and mark timelines on our side. Happy to schedule a 20-min follow-up with our Security lead (Monica) if you have any questions about redaction or scope.

Thanks,

Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.ai

Attachments: bridge-letter-template.docx (template we use for simple attestations)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@crestlinehealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@crestlinehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 09:28:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II artifacts request + vendor security questionnaire kickoff

Sergio —

Thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2 Type II: we completed a Type II audit in Sep 2026 with Shieldpoint LLP. We can share a redacted copy of the full report and we maintain a standard bridge letter that extends attestation to the current quarter. I'm attaching a short "SOC2_interim_summary.pdf" that covers scope and date ranges.
- Portal: we use an internal vendor portal (vendor.crestlinehealth.com). I'll request an upload invite for security@redwood.ai and copy procurement. Expect the invite by end of day tomorrow once procurement approves the access level.
- VSQ: procurement prefers we run our questionnaire first (it streamlines legal). Procurement has been looped. If procurement needs anything from your side on the contract, they asked for a short redlines summary.

High level timeline:
- Today/Tomorrow: Procurement reviews and issues vendor portal invite.
- By Tue 16 Feb: we'll upload redacted Type II and bridge letter to the portal.
- If you need a signed bridge letter, legal may require DocuSign and a PO; we can scope that after portal upload.

Attaching the interim summary for now. Let me know if you need additional fields from the report (control names, in-scope systems, encryption at rest details).

Best,

Liam O'Connor
Head of InfoSec | Crestline Health
liam.oconnor@crestlinehealth.com

Attachments: SOC2_interim_summary.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@crestlinehealth.com>, Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II artifacts request + vendor security questionnaire kickoff

Hi Liam/Alyssa —

Appreciate the summary and the interim doc. A few clarification items from our security intake so we can validate scope quickly: 

1) In-scope systems: can you confirm whether the Type II scope included the APIs that process PHI (we're evaluating HIPAA considerations) or whether those systems were scoped out?
2) Control evidence: once in the vendor portal we'll look for evidence of encryption at rest, key management (KMS/HSM), access control reviews, and change control artifacts for the last six months. A short index of which artifact maps to which control is extremely helpful.
3) Bridge letter: if you can upload the standard bridge letter template (or confirm you'll sign ours), that covers our compliance team while we finish contract terms.

Also to speed procurement, here's a one-click link to our lightweight vendor questionnaire — it only takes a few minutes if your team prefers filling ours instead of running your questionnaire: https://redwood.ai/vendor-questionnaire/crestline-DL-2027-0893 (we will accept a completed Crestline vendor questionnaire as well).

If possible, can we have the portal invite sent to security@redwood.ai and procurement@redwood.ai by end of day tomorrow (Wed 17 Feb)? If there are any policies around redaction or PII removal you require before upload, please flag them.

If helpful, I'm available Wed 17 Feb 10-11am PST for a 20-min screen-share to walk the evidence index.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Security Lead, Integrations | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@crestlinehealth.com>, Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@crestlinehealth.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@crestlinehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II artifacts request + vendor security questionnaire kickoff

Liam / Alyssa —

Thanks for moving this along. I'll watch for the portal invite and the upload. Once the redacted report and bridge letter are available, we'll run a short internal review and come back with any follow-up items — otherwise this should be sufficient for our standard procurement checklist.

If procurement or legal require anything specific for contract execution (PO number, billing address, or signing authority), please let me know and I can connect your procurement contact directly to ours to close quickly.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the portal invite.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive (Enterprise) | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
